```sql
WITH base_sites AS (
    -- Filter sites
    SELECT
        id,
        site_name,
        zone,
        installed_kw,
        CASE WHEN installed_kw >= 386.6 THEN 'A' WHEN installed_kw >= 93.3 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS installed_kw_tier,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(zone), 1, 2) AS zone_prefix,
        CONCAT_WS(' / ', site_name, zone) AS site_name_zone_label
    FROM sites
    WHERE tariff <> 'FLAT'
),
latest_per_key AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per zone
    SELECT
        id,
        site_name,
        zone,
        installed_kw,
        installed_kw_tier,
        zone_prefix,
        site_name_zone_label
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zone ORDER BY installed_kw, id) AS rn
        FROM base_sites
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM latest_per_key
    WHERE installed_kw > (SELECT AVG(installed_kw) FROM latest_per_key)
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(zone, 'UNKNOWN') AS zone_or_unknown,
        COALESCE(installed_kw, 0.0) AS installed_kw_filled
    FROM without_matches
)
SELECT
    id,
    installed_kw_tier,
    zone_prefix,
    site_name_zone_label,
    zone_or_unknown,
    FLOOR(installed_kw / 100) * 100 AS installed_kw_bucket,
    CASE WHEN installed_kw_filled >= 351.5 THEN 'large' WHEN installed_kw_filled >= 203.0 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS installed_kw_filled_tier
FROM annotated
ORDER BY zone_prefix, id
LIMIT 20
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base_sites = (
    df_sites
    .filter(F.col("tariff") != "FLAT")
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_name",
        "zone",
        "installed_kw",
        F.when(F.col("installed_kw") >= 386.6, "A").when(F.col("installed_kw") >= 93.3, "B").otherwise("C").alias("installed_kw_tier"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("zone")), 1, 2).alias("zone_prefix"),
        F.concat_ws(" / ", F.col("site_name"), F.col("zone")).alias("site_name_zone_label"),
    )
)

latest_per_key = (
    base_sites
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("zone").orderBy("installed_kw", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

without_matches = (
    latest_per_key
    .crossJoin(latest_per_key.agg(F.avg("installed_kw").alias("overall_avg_installed_kw")))
    .filter(F.col("installed_kw") > F.col("overall_avg_installed_kw"))
    .drop("overall_avg_installed_kw")
)

annotated = (
    without_matches
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("zone"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("zone_or_unknown"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("installed_kw"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("installed_kw_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    annotated
    .select(
        "id",
        "installed_kw_tier",
        "zone_prefix",
        "site_name_zone_label",
        "zone_or_unknown",
        (F.floor(F.col("installed_kw") / 100) * 100).alias("installed_kw_bucket"),
        F.when(F.col("installed_kw_filled") >= 351.5, "large").when(F.col("installed_kw_filled") >= 203.0, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("installed_kw_filled_tier"),
    )
    .orderBy("zone_prefix", "id")
    .limit(20)
)
```

```sql
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter tickets
    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        opened_at,
        priority,
        tags
    FROM tickets
    WHERE requester_id <= 15
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous opened_at per agent_id
    SELECT *, LAG(opened_at) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY opened_at, id) AS prev_opened_at
    FROM filtered
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_opened_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(opened_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_opened_at)) / 60 > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        agent_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(opened_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(opened_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(opened_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(opened_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY agent_id, burst_id
),
derived AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_end) AS session_end_month,
        duration_min + burst_id AS duration_min_plus_burst_id
    FROM per_session
)
SELECT
    agent_id,
    burst_id,
    session_start,
    n_events,
    duration_min,
    duration_min_plus_burst_id
FROM derived
ORDER BY n_events DESC, session_start DESC, agent_id, burst_id
LIMIT 5
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_tickets
    .filter(F.col("requester_id") <= 15)
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "opened_at",
        "priority",
        "tags",
    )
)

with_prev = filtered.withColumn("prev_opened_at", F.lag("opened_at").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy("opened_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_opened_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("opened_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_opened_at")) / 60 > 30), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy("opened_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("agent_id", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("opened_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("opened_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("opened_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("opened_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

derived = (
    per_session
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("session_end")).alias("session_end_month"),
        (F.col("duration_min") + F.col("burst_id")).alias("duration_min_plus_burst_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    derived
    .select(
        "agent_id",
        "burst_id",
        "session_start",
        "n_events",
        "duration_min",
        "duration_min_plus_burst_id",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("n_events").desc(),
        F.col("session_start").desc(),
        "agent_id",
        "burst_id",
    )
    .limit(5)
)
```

```sql
WITH joined_ranges AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_7d,
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_7d
    FROM plays a
    LEFT JOIN plays b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
play_stats AS (
    -- Per-listener plays metrics
    SELECT listener_id, MIN(ms_played) AS min_play_ms_played
    FROM plays
    GROUP BY listener_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach plays metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.min_play_ms_played
    FROM joined_ranges s
    LEFT JOIN play_stats p ON p.listener_id = s.listener_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    played_at,
    prior_rows_7d,
    prior_ms_played_7d,
    min_play_ms_played,
    TO_DATE(played_at) AS played_at_date,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', played_at) AS days_since_played_at
FROM summarized_rows
ORDER BY days_since_played_at DESC, played_at_date DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

joined_ranges = (
    df_plays.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_plays.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.listener_id") == F.col("a.listener_id"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") < F.col("a.played_at"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") >= F.col("a.played_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.played_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_7d"),
        F.sum("b.ms_played").alias("prior_ms_played_7d"),
    )
)

play_stats = (
    df_plays
    .groupBy("listener_id")
    .agg(F.min("ms_played").alias("min_play_ms_played"))
)

summarized_rows = (
    joined_ranges.alias("s")
    .join(play_stats.alias("p"), F.col("p.listener_id") == F.col("s.listener_id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "p.min_play_ms_played")
)

result = (
    summarized_rows
    .select(
        "id",
        "played_at",
        "prior_rows_7d",
        "prior_ms_played_7d",
        "min_play_ms_played",
        F.to_date(F.col("played_at")).alias("played_at_date"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("played_at")).alias("days_since_played_at"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("days_since_played_at").desc(), F.col("played_at_date").desc())
)
```

```sql
WITH recent AS (
    -- Scope the stock_moves rows
    SELECT
        id,
        warehouse_id,
        sku_id,
        move_type,
        qty,
        moved_at,
        operator,
        unit_price,
        DATE_FORMAT(moved_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS moved_at_label,
        COALESCE(qty, 0) AS qty_filled
    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE (move_type IN ('ADJUST', 'OUTBOUND', 'TRANSFER') OR warehouse_id IS NOT NULL)
),
joined AS (
    -- Join warehouses
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.warehouse_id,
        s.sku_id,
        s.qty,
        s.moved_at,
        s.operator,
        w.opened_on AS warehouse_opened_on,
        w.city AS warehouse_city,
        w.capacity AS warehouse_capacity,
        sk.is_active AS sku_is_active
    FROM recent s
    LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id
    JOIN skus sk ON sk.id = s.sku_id
),
filtered AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM joined
    WHERE warehouse_capacity < (SELECT MAX(warehouse_capacity) FROM joined)
),
joined_sku AS (
    -- Attach sku attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.warehouse_id,
        s.sku_id,
        s.moved_at,
        s.warehouse_opened_on,
        s.warehouse_city,
        s.warehouse_capacity,
        s.sku_is_active,
        sk.is_active AS sku_is_active_2,
        sk.sku_code
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN skus sk ON sk.id = s.sku_id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Join skus
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.warehouse_id,
        s.sku_id,
        s.moved_at,
        s.warehouse_opened_on,
        s.warehouse_capacity,
        s.sku_is_active,
        s.sku_code,
        sk.sku_code AS sku_sku_code,
        sk.weight_kg AS sku_weight_kg,
        sk.labels AS sku_labels
    FROM joined_sku s
    JOIN skus sk ON sk.id = s.sku_id
),
exploded AS (
    -- One row per sku_label

        s.id,
        s.warehouse_id,
        s.sku_id,
        s.moved_at,
        s.warehouse_opened_on,
        s.warehouse_capacity,
        s.sku_is_active,
        s.sku_code,
        s.sku_sku_code,
        s.sku_weight_kg,
        t.sku_label
    FROM enriched s
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(s.sku_labels) t AS sku_label
)
-- Final projection
SELECT

    moved_at,
    warehouse_opened_on,
    warehouse_capacity,
    sku_code,
    sku_sku_code,
```

```sql
WITH scoped_artists AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        artist_name,
        genre,
        country,
        debut_year,
        is_verified,
        ABS(debut_year - 2006) AS debut_year_distance,
        LOWER(TRIM(artist_name)) AS artist_name_clean
    FROM artists
    WHERE debut_year <= 2020
      AND LOWER(artist_name) LIKE '%te%'
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per country
    SELECT
        id,
        artist_name,
        genre,
        country,
        debut_year,
        is_verified,
        debut_year_distance,
        artist_name_clean
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY debut_year DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM scoped_artists
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        genre,
        artist_name_clean,
        RANK() OVER w_country_by_debut_year AS debut_year_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY debut_year, id) AS rn,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(genre) OVER (PARTITION BY country)) AS distinct_genre_in_country,
        MIN(debut_year_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY debut_year, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_debut_year_distance_so_far,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS rows_in_country,
        debut_year_distance - LAG(debut_year_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY debut_year, id) AS debut_year_distance_change
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_country_by_debut_year AS (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY debut_year, id)
),
tagged AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(TRIM(artist_name_clean)) AS artist_name_clean_len,
        CONCAT_WS(' / ', artist_name_clean, genre) AS artist_name_clean_genre_label
    FROM with_windows
),
latest_per_key AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per genre
    SELECT
        id,
        genre,
        artist_name_clean,
        debut_year_rank,
        rn,
        distinct_genre_in_country,
```

```sql
    SELECT *
```

```sql
    WHERE status IN ('APPROVED', 'OPEN')

ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions

        id,
        policy_id,
        adjuster_id,
        claim_date,
        claim_type,
        claimed_amount,
        status,
        reported_at,
        LEAD(claimed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id ORDER BY claim_date, id) AS next_claimed_amount,
        DATEDIFF(claim_date, LAG(claim_date) OVER w_policy_id_by_claim_date) AS days_since_prev_claim_date,

        SUM(claimed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id ORDER BY reported_at NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_claimed_amount
    FROM recent
    WINDOW w_policy_id_by_claim_date AS (PARTITION BY policy_id ORDER BY claim_date, id)
),
claim_type_stats AS (
    -- Avg days_since_prev_claim_date per claim_type
    SELECT claim_type, AVG(days_since_prev_claim_date) AS avg_days_since_prev_claim_date
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY claim_type
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_days_since_prev_claim_date,
        ROUND(s.days_since_prev_claim_date - g.avg_days_since_prev_claim_date, 2) AS days_since_prev_claim_date_minus_avg
    FROM ranked s
    JOIN claim_type_stats g ON g.claim_type = s.claim_type

),
labeled AS (
```

```sql
        policy_id,
        adjuster_id,
        claim_date,
        claimed_amount,
        status,
        reported_at,
        LAST_DAY(claim_date) AS claim_date_month_end
    FROM claims

with_details AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.policy_id,
        s.adjuster_id,
        s.claim_date,
        s.claimed_amount,
        s.status,
        s.reported_at,
        s.claim_date_month_end,
        a.level AS adjuster_level,
        a.adjuster_name,
        p.product AS policy_product
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN adjusters a ON a.id = s.adjuster_id AND a.team IN ('Health', 'Travel', 'Property')
    LEFT JOIN policies p ON p.id = s.policy_id
    WHERE LENGTH(TRIM(a.adjuster_name)) >= 4
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(claimed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_product) AS policy_product_sum_claimed_amount,
        LEAD(claim_date_month_end) OVER (PARTITION BY adjuster_id ORDER BY adjuster_level NULLS LAST, id) AS next_claim_date_month_end,
        LAST_VALUE(claimed_amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY policy_product, adjuster_id ORDER BY reported_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_claimed_amount,

        COUNT(*) OVER w_policy_product AS rows_in_policy_product,
        ROUND(adjuster_level - AVG(adjuster_level) OVER w_policy_product, 2) AS adjuster_level_vs_policy_product_avg,
        NTH_VALUE(claimed_amount, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_product, adjuster_id ORDER BY reported_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_claimed_amount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY adjuster_id ORDER BY adjuster_level NULLS LAST, id) AS adjuster_level_dense_rank
    FROM with_details
    WINDOW w_policy_product_by_claim_date AS (PARTITION BY policy_product ORDER BY claim_date DESC), w_policy_product AS (PARTITION BY policy_product)

tagged AS (

    FROM with_windows
```

```sql
    SELECT *, LAG(opened_at) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY opened_at, id) AS prev_opened_at
    FROM recent_tickets

flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_opened_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(opened_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_opened_at)) / 60 > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        channel,
        burst_id,
        MIN(opened_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(opened_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(opened_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(opened_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY channel, burst_id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        YEAR(session_end) AS session_end_year,
        DATE_FORMAT(session_end, 'yyyy-MM') AS session_end_label,
        ROUND(burst_id / NULLIF(events, 0), 3) AS burst_id_per_events
    FROM session_summary
)
-- Final projection

FROM enriched
```

```sql
        id,
```
```sql
        requester_id,
```

```sql
    FROM scoped_tickets

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_opened_at IS NULL OR opened_at > prev_opened_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
)
-- Final projection

    requester_id,
    opened_at,
    channel,
    csat_distance,
    prev_opened_at,
    new_session_flag
```

```python
        "qty",
        "moved_at",

        "unit_price",
```

```python
w_warehouse_id_by_unit_price = Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc(), "id")
w_operator_warehouse_id = Window.partitionBy("operator", "warehouse_id")
w_operator = Window.partitionBy("operator")
w_warehouse_id_sku_id_by_moved = Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id", "sku_id").orderBy(F.col("moved_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

        "unit_price",
        F.rank().over(w_warehouse_id_by_unit_price).alias("unit_price_rank"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id", "sku_id").orderBy(F.col("moved_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id")), 3).alias("moved_at_percent_rank"),
        (F.col("unit_price") - F.lag("unit_price").over(Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id", F.to_date("moved_at")).orderBy(F.col("qty").desc(), "id"))).alias("unit_price_change"),
        F.round(F.col("unit_price") - F.avg("unit_price").over(w_operator_warehouse_id), 2).alias("unit_price_vs_operator_warehouse_id_avg"),
        F.round(F.col("qty") - F.avg("qty").over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id", "warehouse_id")), 2).alias("qty_vs_sku_id_warehouse_id_avg"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("operator")).alias("rows_in_operator"),
        F.lead("qty", 3, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id").orderBy(F.col("moved_at").desc(), "id")).alias("next3_qty"),
        F.last("qty", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_qty"),
        F.sum("unit_price").over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_unit_price"),
        F.round(F.col("qty") / F.nullif(F.sum("qty").over(w_operator), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("qty_share_of_operator"),
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
)
```

```sql
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor,
        DATE_FORMAT(event_at, 'MMM yyyy') AS event_at_label
    FROM ticket_events
    WHERE event_type = 'replied'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event_at per actor
    SELECT *, LAG(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id) AS prev_event_at
    FROM base
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(event_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_event_at)) / 60 > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        actor,
        burst_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY actor, burst_id
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        actor,
        SUM(CASE WHEN actor IS NOT NULL THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS event_count_actor_is_not_null,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM session_summary
    WHERE duration_min < 192.0
    GROUP BY actor
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        actor,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY event_count_actor_is_not_null DESC, actor) AS event_count_actor_is_not_null_dense_rank,
        NTH_VALUE(row_count, 2) OVER (ORDER BY event_count_actor_is_not_null DESC, actor ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_row_count,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_all_by_event_count_actor_is AS event_count_actor_is_not_null_quartile,
        LAG(row_count) OVER (ORDER BY event_count_actor_is_not_null DESC, actor) AS prev_row_count,
        LAG(row_count, 1, 0) OVER w_all_by_event_count_actor_is AS prev_row_count_2,
```
